ESET Research discovers vulnerable UEFI shims undermining devices’ Secure Boot
headlines.summary: ESET researchers discovered 11 old Microsoft-signed UEFI shim bootloaders with decade-old vulnerabilities that allow attackers to bypass UEFI Secure Boot on most UEFI-based systems.
